capabilities: Connect other vaults on the same computer
Insert links to notes in connected vaults
Open a Bridge link in its target vault
Search note names across connected vaults
Manage connections in settings (rename, relocate, remove)
disambiguation: Not a vault syncing or merging tool; the vaults stay fully separate and the other vault is read-only.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; installed manually from release files. Free, MIT-licensed, makes no network requests. Custom bridge:// links work via a workaround because Obsidian has no official way for plugins to handle custom link types; clicking links in Live Preview is still being tested.
motivation: The author wished they could point from a note in one vault to a note in another and just click it.
problem: Obsidian links only resolve within a single vault, so notes kept in separate vaults cannot reference each other with clickable links.

requires.name: Obsidian 1.7.2+ desktop; target vaults need no plugin

summary: Cross-vault linker that inserts clickable links to notes in other local vaults and opens them in their own vault, without merging or syncing the vaults.
